description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractUploadManager in the AWS SDK for PHP, which encapsulates the logic for managing multipart uploads to Amazon S3 or Glacier. It handles initiation, progress, and completion of multipart uploads, and provides a foundation for specific implementations.

classes.name: AbstractUploadManager
classes.description: Abstract class managing multipart upload lifecycle, requiring subclasses to specify some workflow-specific methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the upload manager with a client and configuration, loading upload workflow info and determining initial state.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current upload state object.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Executes the multipart upload synchronously, waiting for completion.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that represents the ongoing multipart upload process or starts it if not already begun.

methods.name: transformException
methods.description: Transforms exceptions into MultipartUploadException if they are AwsException.

methods.name: buildFailureCatch
methods.description: Creates a callback to handle and transform exceptions during promise execution.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Abstract method to load service-specific upload workflow information.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the size of each part for upload.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Abstract method to process the result of an upload part operation.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Abstract method returning parameters to initiate the multipart upload.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Abstract method returning parameters to complete the multipart upload.

methods.name: determineState
methods.description: Creates and returns the upload state object based on current info and config.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes a service command asynchronously with optional pre-processing.

methods.name: getResultHandler
methods.description: Provides a response handler that processes successful results and errors for upload parts.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Abstract method to generate upload part commands.
